core.name: Johan P

core.name: Restaurang Möllan

core.name: Atmosfär
core.why: Bistro on Fersens väg by Magistratsparken, open since the 2000s; Michelin listed.

core.name: Vollmers
core.why: Mats Vollmer's fine-dining restaurant on Tegelgårdsgatan, Malmö's best-known Michelin-starred restaurant.

core.name: Jalla Jalla
core.why: Falafel stand at Möllevången, described as a piece of Malmö legend and the best-known falafel in town.

core.name: Krua Thai

core.name: Moosehead

core.name: Vegegården
core.why: All-vegan Asian buffet on Rörsjögatan, a long-running Malmö staple.

core.name: Årstiderna i Kockska huset
core.why: Traditional Swedish fine dining in the vaulted cellars of the 1520s Kockska huset by Stortorget, open since the 1990s.

core.name: Brasserie Sture
core.why: Adelgatan brasserie with the Sture name going back to 1912, revived as a classic brasserie; Michelin listed.

core.name: Saltimporten
core.why: Lunch-only canteen in the Frihamnen harbour since 2012, famous far beyond its size; White Guide listed.

core.name: Bullen
core.why: Storgatan beer hall with a history on the site back to 1897 and a 1960s interior; Malmö's archetypal old pub.

core.name: Far i Hatten
core.why: Folkets Park's original park restaurant (building from 1892): restaurant, beer garden and dance floor.

core.name: Steakhouse Lilla Torg
core.why: Long-running steakhouse on Lilla Torg; already in the game.

core.name: Limhamns Fiskrökeri
core.why: Smokehouse and fish restaurant by the harbour in Limhamn.

core.name: Malmö Brewing Co & Taproom
core.why: Brewery taproom on Bergsgatan since 2010, Malmö's best-known beer place.

core.name: Mando Steakhouse
core.why: Skomakaregatan steakhouse since 1966, famous for its plankstek (on the menu since 1975, well over a million served).

core.name: Mello Yello
core.why: Bar-restaurant on Lilla Torg (OSM spells it Mellow Yellow), one of the square's long-running anchors.

core.name: Nyhavn
core.why: Pub with the big outdoor serving on Möllevångstorget.

core.name: Pickwick
core.why: English pub on Stadt Hamburgsgatan by Malmborgen, decades old and a standard meeting point.

core.name: Rådhuskällaren
core.why: Restaurant in the cellar of the town hall on Stortorget, a long-standing venue for dinners, julbord and parties.

core.name: Victors
core.why: Bar and restaurant on Lilla Torg with the big terrace, a fixture since at least the early 2000s.

core.name: Ölkaféet
core.why: Cheap-pint beer bar on Södra Skolgatan at Möllan with a busy terrace; a neighbourhood institution.

core.name: Falafel Baghdad
core.why: One of Malmö's original falafel places (OSM spells it Falafel Bagdad).

core.name: Kin Long
core.why: Malmö's oldest Chinese restaurant (since 1964), on Rådmansgatan; also White Guide listed.

core.name: Syltan
core.why: Pub at Östra Förstadsgatan by Värnhem, with a pub on the site since the 1970s.

core.why: The original Falafel No 1 stand by Jägersro, from the family that built Malmö's best-known falafel brand starting in the late 1980s.

notes:
Core is 30, not 40: past the obvious institutions (Mando, Bullen, Kin Long, Johan P, Årstiderna, Operagrillen, Sture, the Lilla Torg bars, the Möllan pubs and falafel), the evidence thins out fast, and I would rather the owner promote from `everything` than pad. Good candidates for promotion: Grand Malmö (Grand Öl & Mat, Monbijougatan, ~2013), Izakaya Koi (the early-1990s place that started Lilla Torg's restaurant wave), Falafel Mästaren (Slottsgatan 33; The Local says Malmö's first falafel place, 1988), Restaurang Ribersborg (Limhamnsvägen), Gustav Adolf restaurant & café, Spot (Stora Nygatan), Mrs Brown, Sankt Markus Vinkällare (old julbord place, poor recent reviews), Lemongrass, Kvarnby Byakrog, Västra station (the old station building; it is changing hands, with Frantzén Group's Brasserie Astoria opening there in 2027, so wait).
Name changes seen in OSM: Izakaya Koi's way/1091108899 is now 'Être Bistro' and 'Koi' is way/1091108937 (was The Coconut), so Koi may have moved within Lilla Torg; Riket's node/6341952008 is now 'La cave vinbar', so White Guide's Riket may have closed or moved. Bastard closed in 2020 and became Ruths (same address, Mäster Johansgatan 11).
Display names: OSM spells Mello Yello as 'Mellow Yellow' and Falafel Baghdad as 'Falafel Bagdad'; the core entries use the real names.
Chains dropped include Pølsemannen (a Malmö-born hot-dog chain with many stands; the owner may still want one, e.g. node/1181418068 at Centralen), China Box, Spoonery, Noi, Helsingburger, Aiko Sushi, Sabaidee, Jensens Bøfhus (leaving Sweden). Falafel No 1 is kept in core despite having been a brand with many branches, because the original stand is the institution; the other 'Falafel N.1' entries are separate businesses and sit in everything. Other same-name duplicates are dropped as branches, keeping the entry with more signals or the older one.
Not verified, but believed to be closed or not a restaurant: Tempel, Glassfabriken and Smörgåstårtan from the brainstorm are not restaurants in OSM and I found no evidence for them. Rådhuskällaren had no closure news but I found no recent confirmation either (medium).
`everything` is generous: it keeps all non-chain named places, including many recent pizzerias, sushi and grill places with no signal.
